accessibility.title: Your touchline, your setup
accessibility.body: Motion, haptics, text size, contrast, kit safety, cut-ins and HUD side can change at any time without changing a result.

events.title: Safe or strange
events.body: Safe choices bank a modest result. Risky choices can become a proper club story—or a very expensive Bert anecdote. Powers never depend on these events.

seasonRecap.title: Put the year in the cabinet
seasonRecap.body: The table is only half the story. Check the record, books, development, cup run and awards before contracts open the next season.

pages.title: Bert Rudge
body: So. You're the new manager.
Took a high-school team all the way to the national championship, did you? Very impressive.

pages.title: The books bite
body: This is a REAL professional team. Players earn wages every week, whether they played like champions or garden furniture.
Contracts, facilities and the rest can wait until they matter. For now, keep one eye on the money at the top.

pages.title: Know your doors
body: These are the only doors you need today. I'll explain the machinery behind them when it can actually hurt us.

pages.title: Back to your inbox
body: You've still got one job waiting in your inbox.

inbox.title: HIRE A COACH
inbox.detail: Bert has found several adults with whistles and opinions.

pages.title: Pick your football brain
body: The coach market refreshes each pre-season. Better candidates want a bigger club, more fame and, naturally, more money.

inbox.title: Hire your first head coach
inbox.detail: Choose specialties that fit how you want the squad to grow.

pages.title: One chair. Choose well.
body: A head coach boosts training that matches their two specialties and may teach the club a formation or drill. Their wage is paid every week.

inbox.title: Make room for an assistant
inbox.detail: A Coaching Office unlocks the second staff slot.

pages.title: Build the Coaching Office
body: Build a Coaching Office to unlock the assistant-coach slot. The cost lands now; upkeep starts after it opens.

inbox.title: The assistant desk is open
inbox.detail: Add a second set of specialties—and a second weekly wage.

pages.title: Hire the other assistant
body: An assistant coach adds smaller bonuses from two specialties and brings a second weekly wage. Different strengths give the staff more reach.

inbox.title: Build your Training Pitch
inbox.detail: The $8,000 build cost is in your starting budget. You choose where it goes.

pages.title: Put down the Training Pitch
body: Choose Training Pitch, place it on any clear patch, and approve the $8,000 build. It opens next week and earns your first 10 TP on completion.

inbox.title: Upgrade a facility
inbox.detail: More output and more upkeep after construction finishes.

pages.title: Level up the grounds
body: Select a building to review its upgrade cost, build time and new benefit. The current level stays active until construction finishes.

inbox.title: You found an adjacency bonus
inbox.detail: Some neighbouring facilities work better as a pair.

pages.title: Edges make bonuses
body: Some facility pairs earn a bonus when they share an edge. Corners do not count, because buildings are fussy.

inbox.title: Send your first scout
inbox.detail: Pick a region and a focus, then let the binoculars work.

pages.title: One mission at a time
body: Choose a region and focus, pay the fee, then wait for the due week. A better Scout Office gives clearer reports.

inbox.title: Your scout has reported back
inbox.detail: Open the shortlist before calling any agents.

pages.title: Read the ranges
body: Reports show estimated stat ranges; better Scout Offices narrow them. Open a player to begin transfer talks.

inbox.title: Your 17-player squad is full
inbox.detail: Future signings need a safe sale or release first.

pages.title: Sell to make room
body: The squad is full at 17. Sell or release a safely replaceable player before signing anyone else.

inbox.title: The transfer window is open
inbox.detail: List a player only when the squad—and your heart—can spare them.

pages.title: List, then listen
body: During an open window, list a player to invite bids. A sale adds cash and removes their weekly wage.

inbox.title: A transfer bid has arrived
inbox.detail: Compare the saved offers; accepting one completes the sale.

pages.title: The bid is the bid
body: Each bid is an exact fee. Accepting it moves the player, adds the cash and removes their wage; rejecting it costs nothing.

inbox.title: Your first contract negotiation
inbox.detail: The club fee is only half the conversation. Now convince the player.

pages.title: Numbers first. Pitch second.
body: Set wage, term and a promise. You have up to three rounds, and a Pitch Card can reduce the effective ask by at most 20 percent.

inbox.title: Youth intake is ready
inbox.detail: Choose one academy prospect for the open squad place.

pages.title: The kids have arrived
body: Choose one academy prospect for the open squad place. Check their ratings, archetype, signing bonus and weekly wage.

inbox.title: Your first National Cup
inbox.detail: Every division enters from around Week 10. One upset can change the season.

pages.title: No table. No second chances.
body: Every division enters the seeded Cup around Week 10. Stronger clubs receive opening byes and are kept apart where possible; win to advance.

inbox.title: Your first injury
inbox.detail: Open the player file and check the repaired Starting XI.

pages.title: Out means out
body: An injured player cannot train or play. Check the OUT timer and confirm the automatic Starting XI replacement.
pages.objective: REVIEW THE INJURY AND LINEUP REPAIR.

inbox.title: The emergency loan arrived
inbox.detail: One rescue only. Review repayments and recurring costs.

pages.title: A bridge, not a lifestyle
body: This is the club's only automatic emergency loan, and repayments begin next season. Cut recurring costs now.
pages.objective: REVIEW THE LOAN AND WEEKLY COSTS.

inbox.title: Your first transfer request
inbox.detail: Low morale has become paperwork. Review the player before selling.

pages.title: They want the door
body: Sustained low morale caused this transfer request. Check the player's role, contract and squad cover before listing them.

inbox.title: A player has announced retirement
inbox.detail: They can finish the season before hanging up the boots.

pages.title: The boots have a date
body: The player can finish this season, then leaves the active squad. Plan the farewell and their replacement now.

inbox.title: A club legend leaves a legacy
inbox.detail: Choose a future coach candidate or a mentored youth player.

pages.title: Choose what comes next
body: Choose one legacy: a discounted future coach candidate or a mentored youth player.

inbox.title: Urgent: board cash ultimatum
inbox.detail: Reach the cash target within four weeks or the board will force a sale.

pages.title: Four weeks to recover
body: Reach the board's cash target within four weeks or it will sell one visible candidate at a discount.

inbox.title: Protect one player
inbox.detail: Mark one visible board candidate as untouchable before the deadline.

pages.title: Choose who cannot be sold
body: Protect one player from the board's visible candidate list. You can change the choice while the ultimatum is active.
